description: Free. Returns every agentdatafeed dataset with record count, last update, price per query, filters and links. Call it first to choose a dataset, then use get_sample to inspect records or query_dataset for filtered data. When to use each dataset: amsterdam-events: Use when a user asks what is on in Amsterdam on a date or in a district, plans travel, venues, staffing, security or deliveries around large events, or needs crowd sizes, road closures context or permit status before the event appears on ticket sites. security-advisories: Use when a user asks whether a CVE is actively exploited, which vulnerabilities in a vendor or product to patch first, whether it is used in ransomware campaigns, or needs CISA KEV due dates, required actions and FIRST EPSS exploit probability in one call. eu-tenders: Use when a user asks which public tenders or government contracts are open in an EU country or sector, wants bid opportunities by CPV code or keyword with a deadline, or needs to monitor what public buyers are procuring before the deadline passes. eu-funding: Use when a user asks which EU grants, subsidies or Horizon Europe calls are open or coming up for a topic, sector or organisation type, needs the deadline, budget and call link for an EU funding opportunity, or looks for small cascade funding calls for SMEs and start-ups. cert-advisories: Use when a user asks whether the Dutch, German or French national CERT has warned about a CVE, vendor or product, needs the official European advisory ID and link for a patch or NIS2 report, or wants recent government advisories that cover known exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities.
